lines.t: Yeah
Soldier of God
Heart war
Walk in her crib like, “This ain’t that,”
Devil in her eyes and I still won’t crack.
She wanna make me fall just to feel intact,
If I slip in the flesh, she can say she’s back.
But I don’t move now just to prove I’m tough,
I’m here to love right when the room go rough.
Heart of a servant in a lust‑filled trap,
Real power is mercy when the world want smack.
She don’t just flirt, she strategizin’,
Every look, every laugh, every angle timed in.
She bend the story so I play the role,
If I take the bait, she can crown her soul.
“See, I still got it,” echo in her head,
Trying to bandage old words that left her for dead.
She dress the wound in perfume and pose,
Hunt for a “yes” every time she feels low.
But I see the glitch in the game she runnin’,
This ain’t just thirst, this is trauma comin’.
So I gotta guard my mind and my gaze,
While I see her pain through the smoke and haze.
Walk in her crib like, “This ain’t that,”
Devil in her eyes and I still won’t crack.
She wanna make me fall just to feel intact,
If I slip in the flesh, she can say she’s back.
But I don’t move now just to prove I’m tough,
I’m here to love right when the room go rough.
Heart of a servant in a lust‑filled trap,
Real power is mercy when the world want smack.
She throw shots at my faith, testin’ my talk,
Tryna pull me off the path just to watch me walk.
“Thought you was holy, you still a man,”
Weaponize my weakness in her broken plan.
Subconscious scripts tell her, “Make him trip,”
“If he falls for you, you still got grip.”
Conscious smile, but her soul in a cage,
Using my fall to validate her stage.
So I bow inside though I stand on feet,
Prayin’, “Keep my heart low while the flesh feel heat.”
I’m not her judge, I’m not her prize,
I’m just here to let a different kingdom rise.
I can’t see her as a trophy or an enemy,
I gotta see the little girl under all the energy.
I lay down pride, reputation, rights,
Choose gentle words in the middle of the fight.
If she swing at my worth, I don’t swing back,
If she bait my desire, I stay on track.
I’m here to wash feet in a hostile room,
To want her freedom more than I want my proof.
No ego flex, no secret texts,
No playin’ with fire just to see what’s next.
I die to the urge, I die to the scheme,
If love ain’t clean, then it ain’t my team.
Walk in her crib like, “This ain’t that,”
Devil in her eyes and I still won’t crack.
She wanna make me fall just to feel intact,
But I’d rather see her healed than my ego jacked.
Heart of a servant in a lust‑filled trap,
Hands off, head bowed, spirit on strap.
If one soul learns she’s more than the act,
Then every “no” I spoke was a holy impact.
Yeah, soldier of God in a heart‑code war,
Guardin’ my steps while I guard her core.
If I fall, the script stays the same,
If I stand in love, she might drop that game.
